NEAR's agent economy, measured

NEAR's long-term case is a bet that NEAR Intents becomes the settlement layer for cross-chain money moved by software, including autonomous agents. We test the three halves of that bet separately, from public data only.

Rebuilt by node build.mjs on 2026-10-31T21:34:20.540Z (data through 2026-10-30). Claim and tests: THESIS.md; forward tests: PREREG.md.

What it means for a NEAR holder

Usage moved to NEAR Intents: it settled 82% of NEAR's DEX volume over the last 6 full months and $11.44B in the 90 days to 2026-10-30, 1.76× the 90 days before (T1, T2).

Some of that value reaches NEAR holders, through buybacks rather than protocol fees. Since the fee switch of 2026-02-23, captured Intents revenue buys NEAR on the open market. In the 90 days to 2026-10-30 that was $4.7M, 28% of Intents' fees; NEAR's gas burn added $248.2K (C1).

It is small next to the token. Annualized, captured value is $20.0M, 0.35% a year of NEAR's $5.81B market cap. Over the same months NEAR's total supply grew 2.5% a year net of burns, about $142.7M a year at $4.43; the buyback is 13% of that. The bought-back NEAR is held (2.14M NEAR in buybacks.multisignature.near), not burned.

NEAR's weekly price does not move with Intents volume (r = 0.00 over 94 weeks, T4), and agent commerce is tiny next to Intents (T7). Small agent-size tickets into NEAR do settle (T9).

Read as an investment case: the usage half is proven, value capture exists but covers about 13% of issuance, and the agent half is still an option. The case for the token is that the captured share grows faster than supply; we would call it made when the buyback reaches half of net issuance over a 90-day window.

T1PASSUsage

Did NEAR usage shift from counts to settled value?

Over the last 6 full months (2026-04 → 2026-09), NEAR Intents settled 82% of NEAR's DEX volume. From 2025-01 to 2026-09, NEAR's daily transactions fell 89% and its active accounts 93%, while monthly Intents volume grew 750×.

Rule: share >= 0.70 AND txns and active accounts down >= 50% AND Intents monthly volume up >= 50x (2025-01 -> last full month)

Intents received 15% of NEAR's transactions on 2026-10-24 → 2026-10-30 by NearBlocks' daily stats, and 14% of the 877 transactions in our 11 RPC block samples. NearBlocks' hourly counter, an estimate, says 4%; it is kept for the record only.

T8REPORTAgents

What share of a live agent's money flow is cross-chain?

The agent has sent 501 transactions (robinhood 495, bsc 3, near 3). 3 of them (0.6%; 0.6% of its 498 EVM transactions) moved money across chains, at a cost of 5.42%, 4.92%, 0.38%. Its 3 NEAR transactions are the companion project anchoring its records, not demand.
